LanguageData.DMS_AssaultPiercer.label: Assault Piercer
LanguageData.DMS_AssaultPiercer.description: A heavy submachine gun chambered in large-caliber machine gun rounds, able to fire rapidly and penetrate most armored targets at short range. It is classed as a submachine gun only because the human arsenal has nothing comparable.\n\nThis weapon is designed specifically for automatroid use; without external equipment or augmented strength, an ordinary human will struggle to use it properly.

LanguageData.DMS_PDW.label: PDW
LanguageData.DMS_PDW.description: A mass-produced personal defense weapon, widely issued from starship security to rear-area police forces. Designed from the outset to be fired from the hip, it is not accurate overall, but its powerful pistol caliber and rapid fire let it effectively suppress enemies in corridors, making it an excellent defensive weapon against mechanoids or pirates in boarding actions and urban combat.

LanguageData.DMS_TacticalPistol.description: A large-caliber pistol with fine craftsmanship and extra tactical attachments. Too heavy for a human, but well suited to mechs.\n\nThis weapon is designed specifically for automatroid use; without external equipment or augmented strength, an ordinary human will struggle to use it properly.
